name: the_turned_diameter_is_not_an_orphan
why: Z-C21.2, finding N3 (measured in Z-C21.3). The drawing state counts as «quote_orfane» the dimensions that no edge or vertex shown by the view holds any more, comparing each attached entity with ISldWorks.IsSame against the Edge and Vertex entities of the view. The diameter of a turned part seen from the side is placed by quota_in_tavola on the two SILHOUETTE edges of its cylinder (IAnnotation~GetAttachedEntities3.html: «swSelSilhouettes | ISilhouetteEdge»), and IsSame never recognises them: so a freshly placed, correct diameter was counted as an orphan, and «attenzione_quote» told the reader that the part had changed after the drawing was dimensioned. The fix leaves the silhouette-attached dimensions out of the orphan count and counts them as «dimensions_not_verifiable».
defect_caught: Step 5 dimensions the side view of a plain Ø30 x 60 cylinder: the length 60 between the two end circles seen edge-on (real edges) and the Ø30 between the two silhouettes. On library 0.141.0 «stato.quote_orfane_totali» is 1 (the Ø30), so the first state expectation is RED; after the fix it is 0, and the Ø30 is in «dimensions_not_verifiable_total» = 1. «quote_totali» = 2 is the other half: the count must not go to zero because a dimension disappeared.
_the_numbers: Cylinder Ø30 x 60 by revolution on the front plane, axis along X: volume pi x 15^2 x 60 = 42411.50 mm3. viste_standard: V1 front (the cylinder from the side: two end circles seen edge-on and two silhouettes), V2 top (the same), V3 side (a circle). Probe probe_silhouette_issame, 28/9/2026, stepped shaft Ø20/Ø30 seen from the side: a Ø20 placed with AddVerticalDimension2 on two silhouettes has attached entity types [46, 46] (swSelSILHOUETTES); IsSame of those two entities against the silhouettes the view shows gave 0 hits right after the dimension, after a drawing rebuild and after a model change; the orphan count with Edge and Vertex was 1, while the length 60 between two edge-on circles, alone, was 0. Silhouette against silhouette answered Same for all four at every moment, so adding silhouettes to the visible list would hide real orphans: the dimension is excluded instead.

expect.why: a view hangs on the FILE of the part
from here on the bench works on the drawing
the length between the two end faces, read back: the dimension on REAL edges, the control of this case
the diameter from the two silhouettes of the cylinder, read back with its Ø: without it the state expectations below would prove nothing
THE LINE THAT IS RED ON 0.141.0 (there it is 1, the Ø30). Both dimensions were placed a moment ago on what the view shows: none of them hangs on nothing
the Ø30 is not hidden either: it is counted apart, as a dimension on silhouettes that IsSame cannot check
the length and the diameter are both still in the drawing: zero orphans must not come from a dimension that is gone
the state says in words where the silhouette dimensions went, not only in a number
